description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogMenuConfigurator class, which configures menu items related to performance tracking logs within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface, uses traits for controller and module screen helper functionalities, and modifies the screen based on request parameters.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu display for performance tracker logs, adjusting screens based on user request parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the screen to 'viewMyPerformanceTrackerList' if the 'mode' query parameter equals 'my'; otherwise, defaults to 'viewEmployeePerformanceTrackerList'. It overrides the current module's screen accordingly.
